purpose: Define a provider-independent release manifest and non-authoritative artifact storage observations so an exact AXIOM release can be identified, reconstructed, and assessed for continuity without making a release page, package registry, object store, container registry, or mirror the release authority.
core_invariants: Release identity is the content-addressed manifest bound to an exact accepted source state; a provider release page is only a location/observation.
Artifact identity is its canonical artifact id plus exact byte digest and length; a URL, registry tag, or provider object id is not artifact identity.
Replica observations prove availability of expected bytes; replica count or provider consensus does not promote a release or alter its identity.
Required reconstruction artifacts and their evidence relationships are explicit and fail closed when missing or mismatched.
claim_boundary: This contract does not upload, download, publish, delete, or mutate release artifacts.
This contract does not verify provider account ownership or storage failure-domain independence beyond declared storage classes.
This contract does not make a CI pass, replica majority, provider release page, or registry tag a release promotion authority.
This contract does not claim an artifact is available unless a current exact observation supports that claim.
